description: qou-q9ih D1-b. The ledger's conclusion was that the route needs a HYPOTHESIS stated before looking, not more data. This states one: H, that the irreducible boundary-parabolic PSL(2,C) reps of a 1-cusped hyperbolic manifold form a SINGLE Galois orbit (the conjugates of the geometric rep), so C_irr = [trace field : Q]. If H held, D1-b's node count would be ARITHMETIC -- a field degree -- and neither the NZ gluing datum nor the 1-loop tau would be where the dictionary reads, which redirects the route rather than advancing it. A prediction was recorded before measuring: H FAILS at m135, because an obstruction class is an H^2(M,dM;Z/2) invariant that the Galois action cannot move a rep across, so eight inhabited classes cannot be one orbit. 4_1 and 5_2 are NOT independent evidence (they are what suggested H); the four bundled census manifolds are the test. Scope-(a): the ptolemy DB is firewalled, so the seven wheel fixtures are the whole offline dataset; four are census manifolds, valid for testing H and not automatically valid as D1-b nodes. Irreducible counts only -- the abelian (L-1) convention does not carry to a census manifold. Nothing wired; no fit.
